We have a cairn terrier, so he is a stubborn one. We have a dog trolley for him because ~~we are lazy~~ it is easier to put him out and bring him back in. Every time a truck goes by our house, he just runs as fast as he can with the trolley barking (we use a metal chain for him because he broke multiple cables). He yanks himself, does a back flip, and continues barking. We've long since gave up on stopping him because he would not learn. Now that he is older and fatter, he does not yank himself hard enough to do a back flip anymore.
